stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The system's scalability let it serve more users.
items.sentenceZh: 系统的可扩展性使它能服务更多用户。
items.scene: A small software service grows from one server module into several seamlessly linked modules as a crowd of user devices increases, without interruption. Before-and-after capacity relationship, no brand or readable interface.
items.altText: 用户设备增多时，系统通过增加服务器模块继续稳定服务。

items.sentenceEn: The modular design improved maintainability.
items.sentenceZh: 模块化设计提高了可维护性。
items.scene: Technician removes and replaces one clearly separated component from an orderly machine while surrounding parts remain assembled and working; labeled-free spare module nearby. Show ease of repair, not scaling up.
items.altText: 技术员只更换机器中独立的一个模块，方便维护。

items.meaningZh: 刺激；激励；鼓舞；起刺激作用
items.sentenceEn: The experiment stimulated the children's curiosity.
items.sentenceZh: 实验激发了孩子们的好奇心。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese science museum workshop, children eagerly lean toward a safe magnetic experiment and ask questions through expressive gestures while an educator guides them. Emphasize curiosity sparked by the experiment, no sparks, risk or writing.
items.altText: 中国科学馆里，一个磁力实验激发了孩子们的好奇心。

items.sentenceEn: The adapter ensured compatibility between the devices.
items.sentenceZh: 转接器确保了两台设备的兼容性。
items.scene: Two devices with different connector shapes are successfully linked by a small matching adapter; a clean flow of data moves between them. Show the fitting interface and successful operation, not simple proximity; no logos or text.
items.altText: 转接器连接接口不同的两台设备，使它们正常协作。

items.sentenceEn: She attached a tag to her suitcase.
items.sentenceZh: 她把标签系在自己的行李箱上。
items.scene: Traveler ties a simple blank luggage tag to the handle of her suitcase at an airport check-in area; tag is focal object, no writing, airline logo or barcode.
items.altText: 旅客将空白行李标签系在行李箱提手上。

items.sentenceEn: Concurrency lets one processor make progress on several tasks.
items.sentenceZh: 并发让一个处理器推进多项任务。
items.scene: Conceptual computing diagram: ONE central processing lane alternates short time slices of three different colored task streams, each progressing in turn along a shared timeline. Show interleaving, never two tasks executing simultaneously; no numbers or labels.
items.altText: 一个处理器交替处理三条任务流，使各任务都向前推进。

items.sentenceEn: The climbing wall was almost vertical.
items.sentenceZh: 攀岩墙几乎是垂直的。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese indoor climbing gym, an adult climber safely ascends a nearly upright wall with harness and belayer; floor and wall form a clear right angle. Emphasize up-down orientation, not a sloped hill, no writing.
items.altText: 中国室内攀岩馆里，攀岩者沿近乎垂直的墙面上攀。

items.sentenceEn: Parallelism allowed three tasks to run at once.
items.sentenceZh: 并行使三项任务同时运行。
items.scene: Conceptual computing diagram: THREE separate processor lanes side by side, each executing one distinct colored task at the same moment with aligned start and finish points. Clearly simultaneous execution, unlike interleaving on one lane; no numbers or labels.
items.altText: 三条独立处理器通道在同一时刻分别执行任务。

items.sentenceEn: Swimming helps her relax after work.
items.sentenceZh: 游泳帮助她在下班后放松。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese community swimming pool, an adult woman swims a smooth freestyle lap in a marked lane, with a lifeguard in background. Accurate stroke and water, no racing or danger, no text.
items.altText: 中国社区泳池里，一名女子下班后轻松游泳。

items.sentenceEn: A fleet of fishing boats returned to the harbor.
items.sentenceZh: 一支渔船船队返回港口。
items.scene: A contemporary Chinese coastal fishing fleet of several small working boats moves together toward a safe harbor at dawn, viewed from shore. Cohesive group of vessels, not a single ship, no flags or logos.
items.altText: 中国沿海港口，一支由多艘渔船组成的船队返航。

items.sentenceEn: The two systems made synchronous updates.
items.sentenceZh: 两个系统进行了同步更新。
items.scene: Two separate server systems exchange matching data blocks in lockstep: first system's action waits for matching response from second before both advance together to next stage. Clear paired step-by-step timing, no clocks, numbers or writing.
items.altText: 两个系统每一步相互等待确认后才一起继续更新。

items.sentenceEn: The app used asynchronous processing for uploads.
items.sentenceZh: 应用程序用异步方式处理上传。
items.scene: A software app sends a file-upload task into a background queue and immediately continues another task while the upload proceeds independently; completion notification returns later. Distinct overlapping timelines, no waiting at front, no labels or text.
items.altText: 应用把上传任务放到后台，自己继续处理其他事情，完成后再接收通知。

items.sentenceEn: The catalog showed every pottery design.
items.sentenceZh: 目录展示了所有陶器款式。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese ceramics studio, a buyer leafs through a bound pictorial catalog whose pages contain orderly thumbnail pictures of different ceramic vessels; matching real samples stand nearby. No readable words or prices.
items.altText: 中国陶瓷工作室里，顾客翻阅展示各种陶器款式的图册。

items.sentenceEn: A mutex protected the shared counter.
items.sentenceZh: 互斥锁保护了共享计数器。
items.scene: Software diagram: two independent task streams approach one shared counter resource; a single gate with a simple padlock pictogram admits only one stream at a time while the other visibly waits, then releases it. No real-world prison, no numbers or text.
items.altText: 两条任务流争用共享资源时，互斥锁只允许一条先进入。

items.sentenceEn: At first, he felt like an outsider in the club.
items.sentenceZh: 起初，他在俱乐部里觉得自己像个局外人。
items.scene: At a friendly hobby club meeting, a newcomer stands slightly apart from a small circle of members chatting around a shared project, with tentative expression; one member notices and begins to welcome him. Gentle social distance, no exclusion stereotype.
items.altText: 俱乐部的新来者起初站在圈外，显得尚未融入。

items.sentenceEn: The Go server started a goroutine for each request.
items.sentenceZh: Go 服务器为每个请求启动一个协程。
items.scene: Conceptual Go-program server diagram: one central service spawns several small lightweight independent task ribbons in response to incoming request symbols, coordinated by one runtime across a few processor lanes. Show lightweight concurrent units, not full separate machines; no gopher mascot, code, letters or labels.
items.altText: Go 服务为多个请求各启动一个轻量级协程来处理。

items.sentenceEn: He desperately searched for his keys.
items.sentenceZh: 他拼命寻找钥匙。
items.scene: An adult hurriedly lifts sofa cushions and checks under furniture with anxious focused expression; keys are barely visible in a safe corner of the room. Body language conveys urgent desperation, not physical danger.
items.altText: 男子焦急地翻找沙发与家具下方，拼命寻找钥匙。

items.sentenceEn: The team tracked a metric for daily energy use.
items.sentenceZh: 团队跟踪每日能耗指标。
items.scene: Engineers review one prominent pictorial energy-use gauge and a simple sequence of daily bars on a blank dashboard, then compare a downward trend with an energy-saving device. One measured metric, no numbers, axes labels, units or text.
items.altText: 团队查看能耗图表，跟踪每日能源使用指标。

items.sentenceEn: She received a certificate after the course.
items.sentenceZh: 完成课程后，她获得了一张证书。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese vocational training center, an adult graduate receives a formal blank certificate with an embossed decorative border from an instructor as peers applaud; no readable words, real seals or logos.
items.altText: 中国职业培训中心里，一名学员完成课程后领到证书。

items.sentenceEn: She widened her stance before the throw.
items.sentenceZh: 投掷前，她把站姿调整得更稳。
items.scene: A female athlete on a training field plants her feet wider apart and adjusts balanced body posture before a safe practice throw; a second subtle ghosted pose shows narrower position before adjustment. Focus on stance, not weapon or argument.
items.altText: 女运动员投掷练习前把双脚站得更开，调整稳固姿态。
